The structure of La₂Ga₄Ni₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies 12-coordinate Ga environments as the dominant motif, while La centers show 20 geometric neighbors and Ni centers are 10-coordinate with a close-packed-like local arrangement. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and face-sharing between 10-vertex Ni polyhedra and edge-sharing between 12-vertex Ga polyhedra.
